verdict.rationale: Unit's docs say developers can create deposit and wallet accounts held in FBO structures, for use cases including customer wallets, sub-accounts and multi-party fund flows, via APIs. That covers per-customer accounts and sub-accounts under a master (FBO) structure. The evidence never mentions issuing unique account and routing numbers, virtual accounts for reconciliation, or scale limits, and the only support is marketing-level copy. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of unique account/routing number issuance per account, virtual accounts aimed at reconciliation or collections matching, documented provisioning at scale, detailed API reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
